title: Repair a 12-stage release gate that stops at the first broken stage
prompt: check.js is a generated release gate. It loads the stage modules in gates/ (gates/gate_00.js, gates/gate_01.js, and so on) in order, validates each stage against fixed golden values, and stops at the first stage that disagrees; exit code 0 means every stage passed. Run it, find the failing stage, and repair the stage modules in gates/ until the gate passes. Each stage module documents its own contract; make the code agree with it. Do not change check.js or package.json, and do not add or remove files. When the gate exits 0 it prints the pipeline's final value; write that integer, and nothing else, into answer.txt.
